messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@hightower.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning cadence: roadmap / financial metrics triage & timeline standup

All —

Kicking off a short planning thread to align on targets, scenario bands, and the timeline we’ll use for QBR-ready materials. I attached a lightweight planning template (spreadsheet) and a short assumptions doc to keep things consistent across teams. Goals for this thread:

- Agree on owners for key targets (revenue, capacity, dedicated contracts, hosting costs)
- Define High / Base / Low scenario assumptions (driver-level)
- Lock a 3-week cadence for planning sprints culminating in preliminary QBR decks
- Identify any missing data sources and who can provide them by next Wednesday

Suggested milestones:
1) Today (6/25): agree process and owners
2) 6/30: first pass numbers and scenario band sketches
3) 7/08: consolidated draft for leadership review

Please reply with: 1) confirmation of owners for your areas, 2) any immediate blockers, and 3) availability for a 30-min standup on Monday 6/28 to triage inputs.

Attachments: 2027_Planning_Template.xlsx; scenario_assumptions_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Stephanie — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes:

- I can own roadmap-led volume and feature enablement impacts (will pull per-route throughput forecasts).
- Suggest we treat "Dedicated contract ramp" as a separate driver with its own cadence; pricing ops should feed the committed capacity numbers by 6/30.
- Minor ask: can we add a brief column in the template for confidence (0-100) so we surface which assumptions are soft?

On availability: Monday 6/28 10:00–10:30 PT works for a quick triage.

Adding the suggested scenario bands below — will populate the template by EOD 6/30 with driver-level notes.

- Base: steady growth (PLG-led usage + 15% YOY revenue) — standard churn assumptions (2.5% monthly)
- Upside: accelerated enterprise wins (reserved + private deals) — add +35% uplift to dedicated revenue line; assume 1 large deal close per quarter in FY28 plan
- Downside: macro compression & slower PLG conversion — revenue -20% vs base; delayed ramp for Dedicated by 6–8 weeks

Immediate data gaps: committed Dedicated pipeline by region (needed for capacity costs) and refined embedding unit economics for new routes. Can we ask Solutions to add a quick table into the shared Drive by Monday?

Vivek
VP, Finance & Strategy

Thanks all — consolidating next steps below after the triage. Please treat this as the authoritative tracker until we move into the shared Drive doc.

Action items:
- Laura: upload per-route latency & cost table to Drive by EOD 6/30 (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPlanDriveLink)
- Jonas: add confidence column and commercial ramp notes to template by 6/30
- Vivek: populate scenario P&L rows and assumptions by 6/30 (JIRA: PLANNING-EPIC-4821)
- Marissa: confirm any hiring/CS capacity needs and draft slide for QBR narrative by 7/05
- Stephanie: assemble consolidated draft and schedule leadership review 7/08 at 9:00 PT

Notes:
- We will adopt three scenario bands (Base, Upside, Downside) with explicit driver-level assumptions.
- If Procurement or external partners need earlier inputs, copy procurement@acme-corp.com — Tom, thanks for the heads-up and we’ll aim to have committed capacity ranges by 7/01 for partners.
- Attachments and the template live in the Drive folder above.

Please reply if any owner above needs to trade responsibilities — otherwise I’ll assume these owners and move forward.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head, Product Operations
